customers.vies: No customer has a VIES problem.

empty.work: No customer has an order “{group}” now.

col.messagesHint: Your own new messages in each customer’s own conversation. Its orders’ messages are counted on its Work tab.
col.needsHint: What waits on us, strongest first; then the customer’s urgent orders and our Top / High; last, quiet, “Waiting for deposit”: it waits on the customer’s payment. Each chip opens exactly what it counts.
col.workHint: Its orders by where they are — the Work tab’s groups and words. Each chip opens its Work tab at that group.
col.nextPromiseHint: The earliest promise date of its open orders, from today on
col.pictureHint: The picture of the customer’s newest order
col.overdueFirst: The first {count} customers with money late are read: beyond them a customer may show none.

office.VIES: the VIES check is not valid
office.SDI: the SDI code or PEC is missing
office.TAX: tax data is missing: it can’t be invoiced yet

none.customers: Your role reads customers and changes none: there is no act for the ticked rows.
none.suppliers: Your role reads suppliers and changes none: there is no act for the ticked rows.

bar.tooMany: At most {max} customers at once: select fewer.

why.noNumber: No EU VAT number VIES can check.

prospect.customers: A prospect: only active customers are blocked.
prospect.suppliers: A prospect: only active suppliers are blocked.

door.customers: A customer’s name opens its page with the thread open, in a new tab.
door.suppliers: A supplier’s name opens its page with the thread open, in a new tab.

task.assigneeHint: Each customer’s production supervisor, or one person who may read these customers’ records.
task.noSupervisor_one: {count} customer has no production supervisor: pick a person, or its task is left out.
task.noSupervisor_other: {count} customers have no production supervisor: pick a person, or their tasks are left out.
task.where: Each task is on its own customer: in its thread, in the assignee’s Home › My tasks and in the customer’s open tasks.

namesOther.warn: The text names another customer: {names}. Each customer reads this task in its own thread.
namesOther.tick: This text names no other customer
namesOther.held: The text names another customer: change it, or tick “This text names no other customer”.

supervisor.listHint: The list is the first customer’s; the server judges each of the others.
supervisor.follows: Its orders without a supervisor of their own follow this one.
supervisor.notTold: The customer is not told who it is.
supervisor.notices: {name} will get {count} notices (one per customer). It runs one customer at a time; closing this window stops it before the next one.
supervisor.notReached: Your role does not reach its portal settings: its supervisor is set by someone who does.
supervisor.readFailed: Its settings could not be read: run it again.
supervisor.stopping: Stops after the customer being set now
supervisor.notRun: Not run: the window was stopped before it.
supervisor.summary: {name} supervises {done} of them now. Already so: {same} · not run: {notRun} · left out: {left}.

held.reading: The customers are still being read.

hint.needs: {count} customers have something waiting on us: {req} requests to answer · {rep} replies waiting on us · {late} late orders.
hint.group: {count} customers have at least one order “{group}” · {orders}.
hint.press: Press: show these customers. Again: show all.
hint.partial: Some waiting replies are beyond what one read counts: the number of replies may be higher.

band.aboutBody: The band counts customers, over your customers only and this list’s own view, search and filters; the hint says the orders. A press shows exactly those customers.
band.failed: Where the work stands couldn’t be read

export.heading: The customers of this view
export.note: In code order. Where the work stands is not in the file.

sort.needsHint: (waiting on us, then our priority, then promise date)
sort.name: Name A–Z
sort.capped: More than 2 000 customers in this view: shown by code. Narrow the view to see them in this order.
